notation_guide.S: Middle-octave Sa; bare note letters are middle octave.
notation_guide.upper_octave: An above-dot marks the upper octave, for example Ṡ.
notation_guide.variants: R/G/M/D/N numbers identify swarasthanas, not octaves.
notation_guide.scope: Parent labels use the cited conventional classification, not an exclusive pitch-set derivation. Scales alone do not define a raga.
